frames.narration: Alright, everyone. This is the briefing for Period eleven, week four, District eight. Fifteen and a quarter hours across seventeen sets. After a blackout week, I am going to assume everyone still remembers which way a shelf strip faces. Snack Nuts and Packaged Bulk are the real work, fuel comes with one rule that is not up for discussion, and Specialty Bath includes a small scavenger hunt. Checkpoints along the way, and they count.

frames.title: This Week at a Glance

blocks.html: Not every store has every set. Store lists are on each stop. Your sign-off sheet is the final list.

frames.narration: Here is the week on one screen. Grocery carries seven sets, Health Beauty Care carries five, and Deli, Cosmetics, Natural Foods, and Fuel fill in the rest. Snack Nuts is the big one at four hours, then Natural Foods Packaged Bulk at two and Fuel at two. Fuel counts once: your store has a kiosk or a walk-in, and you set the one you have. Nine of the seventeen are quarter-hour maintenances. Two sets run cold, Butter and Specialty Cheese, and cold product stays out of the case no longer than twenty minutes. Not every store carries every set. Each stop shows which stores have it, and your sign-off sheet is the final word.

frames.narration: Fuel is two hours of new items, kiosk or walk-in, whichever your store has. One rule, and it comes from Fred Meyer: Compass does not carry product between the store and the fuel center, in either direction. Ask store management to get the new items out to the fuel center, and the fuel center handles the discontinued product and the backstock. On the kiosk window wrap-around racks, set them the way the customer sees them, left to right. Standing outside and facing the kiosk, lighters are always on the right. And if a data skin is broken or shopworn and a replacement is on hand, replace it. In this district it is kiosks at eight stores, and twenty-three and six five eight have no fuel set this week.

frames.narration: Eight more quarter-hour maintenances: Canned Fruit, Tea, Convenient Breakfast, Dry Pasta, Foot Care, Natural Foods Crackers, Butter and Margarine, and Specialty Cheese. Two things to know. First, a change is not a delete. Canned Fruit, Convenient Breakfast, and Dry Pasta carry item changes, same product with a new code, and that product stays on the shelf. Check before you pull anything as discontinued. Second, on Specialty Cheese, the olives come off the two-shelf ambient olive rack only. They stay on every other cheese planogram they are on today. Butter and Specialty Cheese are the two cold sets, twenty minutes out of the case at most. Specialty Cheese is on the sign-off at fifty-three only. Tea is not on the list at three nine one and four five nine.
